name: Connecty
description: Free public status pages for up to 5 HTTPS sites with a daily check. Without signing in, an assistant can read any Connecty status page and explain what Connecty is. After OAuth sign-in, it can list, add or remove your own sites, share your status page link, and report sites that were down at the latest daily check or changed in the last 7 days.
author: Connecty
